fieldValues.title: Semantic records puts compass axes from two diagonals on the same line; only its Change line holds one modality
evidence: clerk domains --repo srs-programme, 2026-10-28 (Semantic records block; warnings: 3 tensions on line Perspective, 2 on Action, 3 on Change)
Each of these tensions exists twice as a record (finding 85e2be48)
fieldValues.body:
- This is a suggestion for the affirmation layer, not a correction: which line each modality takes is the owner's to affirm. The agent's reading comes from the domain's own axis choice.
- The clerk's duplicate-or-inner/outer warnings on these lines may be this mixing, not duplication.
- Related slip: srs-context concept cc05d4c9 records an earlier mapping that swapped lines 1 and 3.
